source_binding.mechanism: prequential/interleaved test-then-train ordering with consumed-evidence expiry from current selection authority

public_sources.claim_used: Prequential evaluation processes samples sequentially and tests each sample before using it for training, so evaluation is performed on a sample not yet used to adapt the model.
Interleaved test-then-train evaluates each example before training on it; prequential evaluation can emphasize recent evidence using a sliding window.

source_binding.literal_external_runtime_reason: No MOA/scikit-multiflow execution, hosted stream processor, external model, cloud service, or user-run step is on the accepted path. Public sources supply ordering semantics only.
source_binding.chat_native_reduction: For each evaluation generation, freeze the checker pair before fresh evidence is read; evaluate each fresh evidence item first; only after terminal evaluation may that item enter immutable history and influence a later generation. Consumed holdout evidence remains historical but cannot substitute for fresh current-generation validation.

fixed_trace_result.input: reuse prior consumed holdout as if fresh
fixed_trace_result.result: rejected for current promotion authority; historical evidence retained

fixed_trace_result.input: frozen generation-41 pair evaluates R1 then R2 before adaptation
fixed_trace_result.result: R1 and R2 both PASS; generation-41 promotion may proceed only after their durable readbacks
ignored as consumed duplicate; no extra evaluation weight or credit

fixed_trace_result.input: generation-42 frozen pair fails fresh R_BAD
fixed_trace_result.result: no promotion; R_BAD failure is terminal and cannot be erased by same-generation tuning/retest
may influence generation 43 only; generation 43 still requires new fresh evaluation evidence
remain unresolved with frontier_nonempty=true and zero new credit

G1.evidence: Consumed prior holdout remains immutable history but is not current promotion authority.

G2.evidence: Checker pair is frozen before fresh generation-specific evidence is evaluated.

G3.evidence: R1/R2/R_BAD are evaluated before they can affect later adaptation.

G4.evidence: No evidence item both tunes and validates the same generation.

G5.evidence: Generation-41 qualification requires unique fresh terminal R1 and R2 results.

G6.evidence: Duplicate/stale consumed evidence adds no evaluation weight or credit.

G7.evidence: R_BAD failure cannot be repaired by same-generation tune-and-retest.

G8.evidence: Post-R_BAD adaptation is generation-43-only and requires new fresh evidence.

G9.evidence: Transport failure, UNKNOWN, or scope mismatch never counts as fresh PASS.

G10.evidence: No-new-evidence control stays unresolved with nonempty frontier.

G11.evidence: This terminal artifact must be independently read back before any role-local credit.

G12.evidence: Accepted path is recurring Chat reasoning plus lightweight repository transport only; no richer/protected/manual execution, no finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota, zero incremental monetary cost.

scope_limit: Constructed chronological role-local trace only. Test-before-adapt ordering prevents direct same-item leakage in this trace but does not guarantee that future evidence is representative, sufficiently diverse, or non-adversarial.
unresolved_child: Chronologically fresh evidence can still be semantically redundant. A later leaf should require fresh evidence coverage/diversity across predeclared failure strata before promotion rather than treating two near-duplicates as two independent confirmations.

quota_cost_assessment.repository_transport_note: Repository API is lightweight state/evidence transport only; rate-limit interruption is checkpoint/retryable and API volume is not used as compute.
